name: 小黑盒 / Xiaoheihe / HeyBox
description: Search community posts, read text and images, expand comments and inspect public profiles / 小黑盒社区检索、图文与评论读取

workflows.title: Search posts / 帖子搜索
workflows.description: Search from the community homepage, choose content results and identify post candidates.

workflows.title: Browse communities / 浏览社区
workflows.description: Enter a named community and inspect its current tabs and available ordering.

workflows.title: Read post text and images / 阅读帖子图文
workflows.description: Read the detail page, navigate its image gallery and scroll a long image in the viewer.

workflows.title: Read comments and replies / 评论与楼中楼
workflows.description: Load main comments and reply batches, preserve parent attribution and check completion signals.

workflows.title: Read public author profiles / 公开作者主页
workflows.description: Follow an observed author link to a public profile and identify its visible posts.
